newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early gains.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early gains.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained its early gains and closed firmer at 42.5460/80 to the dollar in interbank trading against a previous close of 42.5495/5500, dealers said.

The taka quoted at 42.5450/5490 in early trade and remained mostly steady in a dull session. The weekend closure of most international markets resulted in thin demand for the dollar, said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The call money rate closed lower at 5.5 percent to 6.0 percent against the previous 6.0 percent to 7.0 percent, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom +88-02-506363
